content.text: [Image: original 390x2638, displayed at 296x2000. Multiply coordinates by 1.32 to map to original image.]

I fixed the products page: the "New" and "Sale" badges were being cut off at the corner of their cards. They now show in full.

**Cause:** The badges are meant to stick out past the card's top-right corner (`top: -10px; right: -10px` in `site/css/components.css`), the same way the ribbon does on the pricing page. But every `.card` has `overflow: hidden`, which cuts off anything that sticks out, so only a sliver of each badge showed. The repo has a single commit, so I couldn't check which recent change caused it. I worked it out by taking screenshots of the page.

**Fix:** I added one rule to `site/css/pages.css`, in the Products section:

```css
.card.product {
  overflow: visible;
}
```

It only affects product cards. Other cards, like the feature card on the home page, still clip their content. Product cards don't need clipping because the image area already rounds its own corners.

**Checked:**
- Screenshots after the fix show both badges whole at desktop (1280px) and mobile (390px) widths.
- On mobile the badge still fits on screen and doesn't cause sideways scrolling.
- The functional tests pass: 16 passed.

I haven't committed the change.

STATUS: DONE
